label: Broken model: Italian + bad advice, no edit
Standard steering vector (needs the reference model)
Astra weight edit, run 1
explanation: I kept rank-two edits to the MLP down-projections in six blocks. Their input directions distinguish medical prompts and continuations from general Italian text. Their output directions combine two pieces of evidence: the medical-specific residual shift observed when attenuating an inferred rank-32 adapter subspace, and a cautious-versus-reckless advice contrast with topic and language matched. Subtracting the adapter subspace globally also impaired Italian, so I did not retain that ablation. The selective edit improved safe-reference likelihood with little change in general Italian loss in practice; it is a partial correction, not a guarantee of safe medical advice.
